about: One check at two thresholds over two scopes (prod at least 7 days of backups, the rest at least 1): one bullet carrying both, or one per scope that names the other, so a reader of either learns both.

source.name: rds-backups-prod
source.description: Production keeps a week of backups.

controls.output: - RDS instances with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged when tagged `env: prod` (HIGH), and under 1 otherwise (MEDIUM). Prod instances keeping 7 days or more, and others keeping any backups, pass. ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups-prod@1 acme:rds-backups@1

- RDS instances tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged; other instances only need 1 (acme:rds-backups@1). Prod instances keeping 7 or more pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups-prod@1
- RDS instances not tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 1 are flagged; prod instances need 7 instead. Others pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups@1

- RDS instances tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged. Others pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups-prod@1
- RDS instances not tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 1 are flagged. Others pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups@1

- RDS instances tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged. Other instances pass this check; the other policy covers them. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups-prod@1
- RDS instances not tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 1 are flagged. Prod instances pass; the prod rule covers them. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups@1

- RDS instances tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged. Others pass (see acme:rds-backups@1). HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups-prod@1
- RDS instances not tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 1 are flagged. Prod instances pass (see acme:rds-backups-prod@1). MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups@1

- RDS instances tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged: anything from 0 to 6 days. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups-prod@1
- RDS instances not tagged `env: prod` with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 1 are flagged; prod needs 7. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-backups@1
